```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Loading necessary packages
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)
pacman::p_load(here)
pacman::p_load(rio)
pacman::p_load(knitr)
pacman::p_load(cowplot)
pacman::p_load(ggpubr)
pacman::p_load(dplyr)
pacman::p_load(DT)
pacman::p_load(RColorBrewer)
pacman::p_load(flexdashboard)
pacman::p_load(kableExtra)


# Importing data
nhanes_data <- import(here("Data", "cleaned_NHANES_final.csv"))
```
## Row {data-height=650}

### NHANES Sample Characteristics

```{r plot-describing-nhanes}
knitr::include_graphics(
  here::here("Figures", "demographic_distribution.png")
)
```

## Row {data-height=350}

### Participants 21 years old or older

```{r gauge-21years-old}
percentage_21_plus <- mean(nhanes_data$age >= 21) * 100

flexdashboard::gauge(
  percentage_21_plus,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  symbol  = "%",
  label   = "Age 21 or older",
  sectors = flexdashboard::gaugeSectors(
    danger = c(0, 50),
    warning = c(50, 75),
    success = c(75, 100)
  )
)
```

### Average SBP over 120 mm Hg

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
percentage_sbp_above_120 <- mean(
  nhanes_data$mean_systolic_bp > 120
) * 100

flexdashboard::valueBox(
  value = paste0(round(percentage_sbp_above_120, 1), "%"),
  caption = "Participants with an average SBP > 120 mmHg",
  color = "firebrick"
)
```
